snapshot_basis.rationale: The active recognition module is the 95-label PopSign-v1 vocabulary. The live web/src/lib/vocabulary.ts content surface includes 5 additional learn_only_labels (help, stop, finish, school, plus) in the classroom category that are NOT recognition targets. This snapshot freezes the 95 PopSign-bound entries so the data/manifests/*.json vocabulary_review block can be hash-pinned against an evidence file that mirrors the manifest label set, while the live vocabulary.ts content evolves independently.

items.label: Hello
items.coachingHint: Start with a clear greeting sign near the face and keep your hand visible in frame.

items.label: Bye
items.coachingHint: Use a small, controlled waving movement with the hand fully visible.

items.label: Thank you
items.coachingHint: Begin near the chin and move outward; keep the palm orientation clear.

items.label: Please
items.coachingHint: Keep the open hand on the chest area and make the movement smooth.

items.label: Yes
items.coachingHint: Use a firm fist handshape and a clear nodding motion.

items.label: No
items.coachingHint: Keep the closing fingers visible and avoid moving too far from the signing space.

items.label: Like
items.coachingHint: Start at the chest and keep the finger movement small enough for the camera to see.

items.label: Not
items.coachingHint: Keep the negative movement clear, centered, and visible from start to finish.

items.label: Have
items.coachingHint: Keep both hands visible near the torso and hold the ending shape briefly.

items.label: Can
items.coachingHint: Use a clear downward movement with both hands staying in frame.

items.label: Go
items.coachingHint: Keep the directional movement centered and finish with a short hold.

items.label: Book
items.coachingHint: Keep both palms visible and open the hands like a book.

items.label: Pen
items.coachingHint: Keep the writing movement small and centered so it stays in frame.

items.label: Pencil
items.coachingHint: Keep the writing handshape visible and make the small motion easy to see.

items.label: Read
items.coachingHint: Keep the base hand steady and the reading movement in the camera view.

items.label: Table
items.coachingHint: Keep both hands visible and make the flat surface shape clear.

items.label: Chair
items.coachingHint: Keep the handshape compact and show the repeated contact clearly.

items.label: Room

items.label: Home
items.coachingHint: Keep the face-side locations visible and make the two touches distinct.

items.label: Bed
items.coachingHint: Keep the head-side hand placement visible and hold the ending shape briefly.

items.label: Who
items.coachingHint: Keep the index finger and chin area visible for the question sign.

items.label: Where

items.label: Why

items.label: Morning

items.label: Night

items.label: Tomorrow

items.label: Yesterday

items.label: Now

items.label: Time

items.label: After

items.label: Before

items.label: Later

items.label: Mom

items.label: Dad
